title: Silicon Valley Tour from San Francisco Private
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children must be accompanied by an adult
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
You will learn the history of San Francisco and the Bay Area, why Silicon Valley is here, and how it started.
We will pick you up from your hotel or residence and take to Silicon Valley. 
We will take pictures of Oracle Campus and the Trimaran of Larry Ellison, as well as both Facebook campuses. 
You will have an opportunity to visit the Computer History Museum (Closed Mon-Tue). We will pass by NASA Ames Visitor Center and visit the NASA Gift Shop (Closed Sun-Mon).
You will visit GooglePlex Gradient Canopy Building and take pictures inside the campus. You will shop in the new Visitor's Center.
You will visit Apple Park Visitor Center in Cupertino.
We will show you the Home of Steve Jobs and the Garage where Hewlett and Packard created the first product of Silicon Valley
After lunch, you will take a 2-hour walking tour of the Stanford University Campus. You will see the Hoover Tower, Church of All Religions, 
Rodin Museum, IT Buildings, Souvenir Shop, Main Quad, and Athletic Facilities.
